According to this theory, people approach digital texts with a mindset suited to social media, which are often not so serious, and devote less mental effort than when they are reading print.
ex.t: 根据这一理论，人们以一种适合社交媒体的心态对待电子文本——往往不那么严肃，投入的脑力也比读纸质文本时少。

ex.s: They are devoted to community service.
Ms Young has also devoted herself to supporting the restaurants in Chinatown.
ex.t: 毕竟，如果不偶尔犯错，任何事都不可能有进步。

ex.s: devoted himself more to art than to medicine
For the past five years, Paula Smith, a historian of science, has devoted herself to re-creating long-forgotten techniques.
ex.t: 在过去的五年里，科学史家 Paula Smith 一直致力于重现早已被遗忘的技术。

ex.s: Now, she is a model and performance artist devoted/devoting to ocean conservation.
ex.t: 以下是我们对这次事故了解的有吸引力的东西，我们已经安装了新技术。

ex.s: After coming back from the US, Deng devoted himself whole-heartedly to the development of the “two bombs”.
ex.t: 从美国回来后，邓稼先全身心投入到“两弹”的研制中。

ex.s: VS Ivy I admire those people who devote their whole lives to one thing.
ex.t: VS Ivy：我钦佩那些将一生奉献给一件事的人。

ex.s: Having devoted himself to a third edition of The English-Chinese Dictionary after his retirement, Lu continued to edit the dictionary on the dining table of his modest Shanghai apartment.
ex.t: 退休后，陆谷孙全身心投入《英汉大词典》第三版的编纂，在他上海简陋公寓的餐桌上继续编辑词典。

ex.s: After Sherlock Holmes made him a household name, Doyle gave up medicine and devoted himself entirely to writing.
ex.t: 在夏洛克·福尔摩斯让他家喻户晓之后，道尔放弃了医学，全身心投入写作。
